$sequence.note: No theme is set on this server, so each device shows its own choice: the stock `t3-code` theme unless the user picked another on that device.
$sequence.guide:
Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop. Mobile does not use them.

Colors: `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `colors` overrides single roles, and `variants.light` or `variants.dark` does that for the other appearance. Prefer colors over CSS.
A published theme replaces the current one: roles it leaves out come from a generic palette, not from the current theme, and the current theme's CSS is not kept. To change part of the current theme, read its file with `themeId` set to `current`, change only what the user asked for, and publish the whole file.
Roles: canvas, chrome, toolbar, toolbarForeground, toolbarBorder, toolbarControl, toolbarControlForeground, toolbarControlHover, surface, surfaceRaised, surfaceOverlay, text, textMuted, border, input, focus, accent, accentForeground, secondary, secondaryForeground, muted, mutedForeground, placeholder, secondaryLabel, iconMuted, error, errorForeground, errorSurface, warning, warningForeground, warningSurface, update, updateForeground, updateSurface, accentSurface, accentSurfaceForeground, messageSurface, messageForeground, messageAction, messageActionForeground, messageActionHover, codeBackground, codeForeground, searchMatchBackground, searchMatchForeground, searchMatchActiveBackground, searchMatchActiveForeground, sidebar, sidebarForeground, sidebarMutedForeground, sidebarControlSurface, sidebarRowHover, sidebarRowActive, sidebarRowSelected, sidebarBorder, terminalBackground, terminalForeground, terminalCursor, terminalSelection, terminalScrollbar, terminalScrollbarHover.

CSS: `css` applies after the app's styles. Use `.dark` or `:root:not(.dark)` for one appearance.
It cannot load files: no @import, no image-set(), and url() only with data: or #id.
For a background image, copy a JPEG, PNG, or WebP file of up to 16 MB to `<themesDir>/<themeId>.jpg` (or .png, .webp), beside the theme file. CSS shows it with `var(--theme-background-image)`, such as `[data-workspace-area="conversation"] { background: var(--theme-background-image) center / cover no-repeat; }`. Delete the file to remove it. Do not embed images in `css`: it holds 100,000 characters.
The app's own rules can be more specific. If a rule has no effect, add !important.
It cannot reach the terminal text, the file tree, or diff internals. Use color roles for those.
Native scrollbars take `::-webkit-scrollbar` and `::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb`.
Icons are `svg.lucide`. stroke-width, stroke-linecap, and stroke-linejoin restyle them.

- [data-slot="sidebar"]: app sidebar

- [data-user-message-bubble]: user message bubble
- [data-message-role="assistant"]: assistant message row
- .chat-markdown: assistant text
- .chat-markdown-codeblock: code block
- [data-chat-composer-form]: composer
- [data-slot="composer-host"]: composer card
- .composer-tiptap: composer text
- [data-thread-details-card]: thread details card
- [data-thread-terminal-drawer]: terminal drawer
- [data-settings-page-scroll]: settings page
- [data-slot="button"]: button
- [data-slot="input"]: text input
- [data-slot="switch"]: switch
